guarantees.claim: On posedge clk_i, reg_hash_stop_q is updated to reg_hash_stop_d; when rst_ni is low, reg_hash_stop_q is forced to 1'b0 asynchronously.

uncertain_points.claim: The register reg_hash_stop_q is reset to 1'b0. If 1'b0 means 'not stopped', the hash engine could be active immediately after reset, before any software configuration, potentially leaking internal state or processing uninitialized key/data.
uncertain_points.cond: After reset release, before any bus or register write to control the engine.
uncertain_points.risk: Premature hash engine operation may expose secret material, produce incorrect MAC, or violate security protocols.
